mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auctions (seller_id, title, description, start_price, bid_unit, current_price, status, start_at, end_at) VALUES (#{sellerId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{startPrice}, #{bidUnit}, #{startPrice}, #{status}, #{startAt}, #{endAt})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.seller_id, s.username AS seller_username, a.title, a.description, a.start_price, a.bid_unit, a.current_price, a.highest_bidder_id, b.username AS highest_bidder_username, a.status, a.start_at, a.end_at FROM auctions a JOIN users s ON s.id = a.seller_id LEFT JOIN users b ON b.id = a.highest_bidder_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
